_doc: VALUE-FREE + PROSE-FREE platinum enterprise analytic brain for a compact (<=9 page) MoSPI Energy Statistics report. Contains no observed values and no generated prose; it defines structure, controls, contracts, formulas, and officer review needs.

templateMeta.name: MoSPI Energy Statistics Enterprise Report
templateMeta.description: Platinum enterprise built-in energy template: nested topics, chapters, sections, executable question contracts with DIRECT and SHARE formulas, answer structures, officer customization controls, data + binder + publication contracts, and slot wiring for compact MoSPI-style energy report generation.

statisticalContext.ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataSources: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

glossary.CMPDI: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute
glossary.MNRE: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
glossary.Proved Reserves: Reserves established with the highest degree of geological confidence.
glossary.Reserve Category: Geological confidence classification: Proved, Indicated, or Inferred.
glossary.reported_value: Published or source-provided value used directly when it is deterministic at the selected grain.
glossary.ExecutionBundle: S3.5 handoff contract consumed by generation; blocked plans are not executed.

buildSteps: Bind dataset columns to canonical energy entities.
Resolve every section question into executable S3/S3.5 roles (including SHARE denominators).
Fill narrative, metric, chart, table, and provenance slots per question.
Assemble front matter, compact analytical sections, and methodology/provenance back matter.
Run readiness and provenance gates before S4 generation.
officerDeliverables: entity binding matrix with evidence and risk

principles: Every control changes structure, presentation, or scope only; it must not fabricate data.
Controls must preserve binder readiness gates and source lineage.
Optional content can be hidden, but blocked required questions cannot be silently generated.

acceptedInputShapes.description: Renewable potential columns wide by source (Wind/Solar/...).
State/UT, source/category, period, and value in tidy panel form.

normalizationHints: Trim whitespace in headers and categorical values.
Map State/UT name variants and reserve-category labels before S3.
Keep source table identifiers as metadata columns where available.
Preserve original column names in lineage even after canonicalization.
Coal/lignite are MT; natural gas is BCM; renewable potential is MW - confirm units before binding.

blockingRules: BLOCKED execution plans are not adapted into runnable analytics.
Missing denominator/base/timeWindow for formulas is BLOCKED, not DEGRADED.
reported_value never falls through to mean when values disagree.
reviewDashboardNeeds: show officer-editable controls without changing locked statistical contracts

analyticalBody.sectionPagePolicy: two compact analytical sections share one flow page to honour the 9-page cap

supportedFormulaTypes.policy: Use reported value or aggregate physical measure according to entity aggregation policy.
Aggregate numerator and denominator at same grain, then divide and scale by 100.
Aggregate numerator and denominator at same grain, multiply by declared multiplier.
Aggregate both sides at same grain; never average row ratios.
Requires current and comparison period at same grain.
Requires explicit baseValue or base period.

failOn: missing source lineage for published component
